llc.formation_doc: Articles of Organization (filed with the State Department of Assessments and Taxation, SDAT)
llc.formation_notes: Statutory processing fee $100 (Corps. & Ass'ns 1-203(b)(4)). Optional expedited processing carries an extra fee (third parties cite $50, not verified: SDAT site blocked automated reading).

sources.title: Md. Code, Corps. & Ass'ns 1-203
sources.quote: For each of the following documents recorded or filed the nonrefundable processing fee is $100: (i) ... articles of organization of a limited liability company

sources.title: Md. Code, Corps. & Ass'ns 1-203
sources.quote: Annual report of a Maryland limited liability company, limited liability partnership, limited partnership ... except a family farm ... $300

sources.title: Md. Code, Tax-Property 11-101
sources.quote: On or before April 15 of each year, a person shall submit an annual report to the Department

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Electing PTE pays 6.50% (top state rate) + 2.25% (lowest local rate) = 8.25% on members' PTE taxable income (2026 Form 510/511D). Nonelecting PTEs withhold on nonresident members.

sources.title: 2026 Form 510/511D Pass-Through Entity Declaration
sources.quote: the tax is the top marginal state tax of 6.50% plus the lowest local income tax rate of 2.25% of members' pass-through

personal_exemption.notes: $3,200 per exemption (taxpayer, spouse, each dependent) when FAGI <= $100,000; phased down above $100,000 single / $150,000 joint, zero above $150,000 single / $200,000 joint. +$1,000 if 65+ or blind.

income_tax_2026.surtaxes: Additional 2% tax on net capital gain income when federal AGI exceeds $350,000 (from tax year 2025). Plus county/Baltimore City income tax 2.25%-3.30% (see local_taxes).

sources.title: Maryland 2025 resident booklet, 2026 estimated tax worksheet (PVW)
2026 estimated tax worksheet instructions
sources.quote: If Your Filing Status is single, dependent, or married filing separately, your standard deduction amount is $3,350.

sources.title: 2026 estimated tax worksheet instructions
sources.quote: If your federal adjusted gross income is greater than $350,000, net capital gain income ... may be subject to an additional 2% tax.

sources.title: 2026 Maryland State and Local Income Tax Withholding Information

estimated_tax.required_if: gross income expected to develop a tax of more than $500 in excess of Maryland withholding
estimated_tax.notes: Covers state + local tax. Fourth payment can be replaced by filing and paying by 2027-01-31. 110% of prior-year tax safe harbor when income rises.

unemployment_2026.notes: Table A in effect for 2026; new employer rate 'may range from 1.0% to 2.6%' (2.6% commonly reported, not stated as a single figure on the official page).

notable: Every resident also pays a county (or Baltimore City) income tax of 2.25% to 3.30% on the same taxable income; Allegany rose to 3.20% and Kent to 3.30% for 2026, Dorchester also 3.30% (https://www.marylandcomptroller.gov/content/dam/mdcomp/tax/instructions/2025/resident-booklet.pdf)

Two new top brackets since 2025: 6.25% and 6.50% above $500,000 / $1,000,000 single (https://www.marylandcomptroller.gov/content/dam/mdcomp/md/state-payroll/memos/2026/2026-maryland-state-and-local-withholding-information.pdf)
Flat standard deduction $3,350 / $6,700 replaces the old 15%-of-income formula (https://www.marylandcomptroller.gov/content/dam/mdcomp/tax/instructions/2025/resident-booklet.pdf)
LLC formation is only $100 but the annual report costs $300, due April 15 (https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/mgawebsite/Laws/StatuteText?article=gca&section=1-203&enactments=false)
uncertain: Standard deduction for 2026 taken from the Comptroller's 2026 estimated tax worksheet ($3,350/$6,700); law provides inflation indexing in later years, final 2026 Form 502 amounts not yet published.
Expedited filing fee and online card fee for Articles of Organization not verified: dat.maryland.gov returns 403 to automated reading.
Late annual report penalty not verified.
New employer UI rate: official page gives only a 1.0%-2.6% range.
Local tax: Comptroller 2026 payroll memo shows Baltimore City 3.20 and Out-of-state 2.25, consistent with the worksheet list.
